purpose: Derive activation_artifact_valid from explicit machine-verifiable subchecks.

derived_boolean.name: activation_artifact_valid
derived_boolean.formula: version_valid AND experiment_matches AND contract_matches AND frozen_references_match AND authorization_reference_matches AND supersession_lineage_valid AND historical_state_consistent AND authority_state_consistent AND holdout_state_consistent AND execution_state_consistent AND comparative_observation_count_consistent AND provenance_non_self_referential AND schema_valid
derived_boolean.failure_behavior: false; report every failed subcheck; never normalize contradictions

checks.requirement: Supported activation version is exactly g3b-execution-authority-activation-v2.
Activation, contract, supersession, and referenced artifacts identify PRAETOR-VERIFY-001.
The authority contract and supersession successor are g3b-execution-authority-contract-v2.
The frozen design identity matches the frozen G3B design commit.
Activation manifest SHA-256 equals the actual manifest bytes and is well formed.
Activation receipt SHA-256 equals the actual receipt bytes and is well formed.
Activation prevalidation SHA-256 equals the actual prevalidation bytes and is well formed.
Activation authorization SHA-256 equals the actual authorization bytes and is well formed.
The authorization commit recorded by the preserved authorization event matches the approved authorization identity.
v2 explicitly supersedes preserved v1, has no circular predecessor/successor, and has one declared successor.
Activation contains a non-empty append-only statement.
Historical authorization fields match manifest/receipt and remain false.
PENDING applicability implies effective authority false and authority-chain fields match referenced artifacts.
Before authorized execution holdout is NOT_ACCESSED and unevaluated.
Execution has not been performed and effective authority remains false.
Comparative observations remain zero before execution.
Activation parent provenance is a valid commit-shaped identifier and is not the containing commit.
Required activation fields have the expected object, string, boolean, integer, and reference shapes.
